title: Density-adaptive MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS
description: MAX_ANNOUNCE_HOPS scales with local density: 15 at sparse, 10 at moderate, 5 at dense, 3 at very dense, 2 at extreme. This is the highest-impact change: at density 50 with hop limit 15, each announce generates thousands of relay transmissions. At hop limit 3, it reaches ~50 additional nodes — enough for local routing. Distant destinations use BR+Yggdrasil. Spec: 05-routing.md §9.4. All three impls.
